# WhatTheStack 2026

WhatTheStack is a community-driven software conference in Skopje, North Macedonia, taking place on 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-20.

## Conference information

- [Home](https://wts.sh/): Conference overview, venue, speakers, and sponsors.
- [Agenda](https://wts.sh/agenda): Published conference schedule.
- [Speakers](https://wts.sh/speakers): Published speaker lineup.
- [Sessions](https://wts.sh/sessions): Published talks and workshops.
- [Sponsors and partners](https://wts.sh/sponsors): Conference sponsors and community partners.
- [FAQ](https://wts.sh/faq): Practical attendee information.
- [Code of Conduct](https://wts.sh/code-of-conduct): Community participation rules.
- [MCP conference guide](https://wts.sh/mcp): Machine-readable conference data and tools.

## Contact

- [About WhatTheStack](https://wts.sh/about)
- [Partnerships](https://wts.sh/partnerships)
